source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.stems: Erect or ascending, 15–50 cm tall, glabrous or inconspicuously pubescent, widely branched
morphology_source_reported.leaves: 3–5 glabrous or nearly glabrous leaflets, 5–12 mm long
morphology_source_reported.inflorescence: Fruit-stage spikes 10–30 mm long on slender 1.5–15 cm peduncles
morphology_source_reported.diagnostic_characters: Long slender peduncles versus the essentially sessile spikes of Dalea reverchonii

cautions: Does not establish Hays County occurrence or nativity; do not export to identification scoring without taxon review
